brief: Distinguish payment from your own balance from a payment that creates a debt.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "What funds the payment?"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "¿Qué financia el pago?"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "O que financia o pagamento?"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Distinguish payment from your own balance from a payment that creates a debt.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Check whether a purchase uses money held or creates a repayment obligation.
instruction.misconception: Treating every successful card or app payment as spending existing money, regardless of the selected funding source.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: A payment can use your existing balance or borrowed funds. The interface alone does not tell you which one.
The stated source is existing money rather than borrowing.
A credit-funded purchase creates an obligation even before repayment.
The funding choice determines whether repayment is owed.
The explicit overdraft terms can create debt despite the label.
Delayed payment funded by borrowing remains a debt commitment.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Check whether a purchase uses money held or creates a repayment obligation.

es-MX.line: Revisa si comprar usa dinero disponible o crea una obligación de devolver.

pt-BR.line: Confira se comprar usa dinheiro disponível ou cria uma obrigação de devolver.

en-US.line: A payment can use your existing balance or borrowed funds. The interface alone does not tell you which one.

pt-BR.line: Um pagamento pode usar seu saldo ou dinheiro emprestado. A tela sozinha não diz qual dos dois.

en-US.prompt: What determines whether debt is created?
